title: AP economy after bifurcation: GSDP, growth, sectors
quote: Agrarian base + growing services, but a 'missing middle': manufacturing only about 11% of GSDP

boxes.title: Bifurcation & its effects
items: **2 June 2014**, **AP Reorganisation Act, 2014**
==**Hyderabad** ≈ **48%** of undivided State's revenue== (₹70,548 cr, 2012-13)
AP got agrarian population, irrigation liabilities, power deficits; Telangana kept IT, industry, capital
Result: AP = **chronic revenue-deficit State**; new capital **Amaravati**
Population **4.09%**, **10th**; GSDP rank **8th**; coastline **1,053.07 km**, **3rd**

boxes.title: Records & sub-sectors
items: 2025-26 largest sub-sectors: **Manufacturing = Livestock 10.84%**
Agri GVA leader: **Fishing & Aquaculture** (constant); livestock at current prices
Services: largest **Trade, Hotels & Restaurants**; Public Admn slowest (**0.05%**)
Base year: AP **2011-12** (⚠ not 2019-20); India new series **2022-23**

boxes.title: Fiscal & regional strains
items: Debt/GSDP **35.15%** (2024-25 RE); revenue deficit ₹48,311 cr
**7 backward districts**: North Coastal Andhra + Rayalaseema; ⚠ **Nalgonda** = Telangana
MPI: highest **Kurnool**, lowest **West Godavari**; AP **6.06%**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Quote the **estimate stage** (FAE/FRE/SRE): 2021-22 "record" **11.43%** became 7.14%
AP slower than India in **2023-24**, faster from **2024-25**
==Fastest sector 2025-26 FAE = services; Q2 2025-26 review = agriculture (13.5%)==
Agri share ≈ **twice** India's; services trails India
Padi Sutralu = **10**; P4 aim = poverty eradication (2025)
PYQ 2017: most POs, phones, banks = **Chittoor, Visakhapatnam, Visakhapatnam**
